Visible Fit & validate control executes native search, training-only selection and separate validation while both authored scenes remain v1
Every candidate retains 180 actual native ticks and independently recomputed training RMSE
Visible Apply changes only the training parameter in scene v2, preserves object IDs and records an atomic receipt
Visible report opens the real canvas with two host-rendered curves, exact CSVs and native JSON evidence; three DOM assertions pass
Restart restores accepted fit and application receipt; visible rollback restores the prior parameter as scene v3 without erasing history
Changing only validation conditions preserves the training winner, produces a genuine failed gate and disables/rejects apply
No renderer JavaScript errors across fit, report, apply, restart, rollback and rejected validation
